root.name: Scotch Game: Hanneken Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Bc4 Bb4+ 5. c3 dxc3 6. O-O cxb2 7. Bxb2 Nf6 8. Ng5 O-O 9. e5 Nxe5

overview: White gambits several pawns in the Scotch Gambit with b2 and c3 pawns captured, then plays e5 and Ng5 for a kingside attack. After 9...Nxe5 White can take on f7. Black can usually get through with accurate defence.

white_ideas.idea: Attack f7 with Bxf7+ and Ng5
Use the open b-file and the lead in development

black_ideas.idea: Return material at the right moment and consolidate

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with White's queenside pawns gone

character.notes: Forcing lines with White sacrificing material.

gambit.notes: White sacrifices several pawns for development.

approach.notes: Rarely chosen at a high level.

level.notes: Long forcing lines must be known.
